source.title: Theoretical Model of Chemomechanical Self-Oscillation in a Two-Enzyme Core–Shell Hydrogel With pH-Gated Microcapsules
source.primary_scope: Full primary HTML and ten-page PDF, Eqs. 1–5 and reduced Eqs. 10–11, Table 1
source.supplement_status: Official supplement and direct local downloads returned HTTP 403; fit details unverified
source.redistribution: Source text, PDFs and supplement are not included or relicensed

implementation_scope.method: Exact scaling of the full four-state source equations, retaining finite substrate relaxations
implementation_scope.free_rate: lambda_g=(k_D^g+k_R^g)/k_D^h is not fixed independently by the published reduced parameter set
implementation_scope.calibration: Finite rates and survey ranges are chosen mathematical parameters, not fitted hardware measurements
implementation_scope.reference_initial_state: Chosen by us; not claimed to be the source's initial condition
implementation_scope.physical_domain: G,U >= 0, x > 0, 0 < phi < 1; no state clipping
implementation_scope.limitations: Bounds conditional on remaining in the polymer-fraction interval; low-urea kinetics and bath approximation not validated across the scan

literature.search_scope: Targeted DOI, title, author and chaos queries; primary equations compared with the related Milster microreactor
literature.conclusion: No exact full-model chaos demonstration identified in this limited search; absence and novelty are not established

result.conclusion: No validated chaotic candidate; unresolved trajectories are not counted as negative results
